reason: I already pay for cosmetics in Finch and games, and $4.99 once with no subscription is easy to justify if I like my pet after a week. The closet and themes are the part I actually want.
objection: Is this just cosmetics? The free app already works, so I only pay if the pet is cute enough that I want to dress it up.
would_change_my_mind: If the hats and colours looked boring in the preview, or if the one-time price became a subscription.
